title: arm-chaos-fi/v1 fault-injection campaign
description: Grid campaign for the ARM64 CHAOS SDC fault-injection tool (plan §1.5). A campaign expands a Cartesian product of grid axes into per-rep single-fault manifests (max_faults=1), runs each via tools/runner.py, collects the 9-class outcome, and summarizes per-cell Wilson 95% CI. One campaign.yaml == one injector across a grid of (target x bit x fault_model x protection_model) cells, each cell run n_per_cell times with deterministic seeds.

campaign_id.description: stable id; used as runs/<campaign_id>/ path

injector.description: which CHAOS injector this campaign drives (runner.py maps to the arm_chaos.py flag). Values beyond gpr/physreg/memory/cache/lsqfwd are forward-declared — runner.py will reject with a clear error until their mapping patch lands.

config.description: platform config family: C0 (baseline), C2 (kp920_proxy), C1 (x86 cross-ISA). C0 is the only one wired today; others land in their own S0 patches.

grid.description: Cartesian product of axis->list. Each axis value must be a scalar (int/float/str) or list-of-scalars; lists are expanded. Common axes: target_index, bit, fault_model, protection_model, vec_lane.

n_per_cell.description: reps per cell (pilot=100, formal=384, low-SDC=663). This machine takes ~92s/run — formal belongs on the healthy machine (§0.4).

base_seed.description: base RNG seed; rep seed = base_seed + cell_ordinal*1000 + rep (§1.5 deterministic replay)

replay_pct.description: % of reps per cell re-run for the §1.5 replay-consistency check; mismatch -> cell frozen in summary

binary.description: path to the workload binary (relative to repo root)

binary_sha256.description: optional sha256 of the binary; runner.py verifies if present

golden_id.description: manifest oracle golden_id resolved by runner.py GOLDEN_IDS

hang_timeout.description: per-rep wall-clock timeout (s); exceeded with no checksum -> Hang
